events.title: What will Trump say this week?

markets.title: Will Trump say "Zohran / Mamdani" before Oct 12, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If Zohran / Mamdani, or a plural or possessive form of Zohran / Mamdani, is stated by Donald Trump before Oct 12, 2026 at 12:00am ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Payout criteria
The word or phrase must be stated by President Donald Trump in public statements, direct quotes published by Source Agencies, or written public statements on his personal social media accounts (Twitter/Truth Social).
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word, must be used.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
 Official acts like Executive Orders or bills signed do not count. 
 Grammatical/tense inflections.
